name: sample_venous_blood_gas
remarks: Baseline venous specimen for the routine CABG operative gas report. This sampler does not model an acid-base complication or replace disease-specific gas panels.
Retain the existing pH bounds of 7.31-7.45, PCO2 bounds of 37-50 mmHg and bicarbonate bounds of 22-28 mmol/L by sampling PCO2 conditionally on pH.

Use the Abbott i-STAT calculated relationships at 37 degrees C: HCO3 = 10^(pH + log10(PCO2) - 7.608) and TCO2 = HCO3 + 0.03 * PCO2. Total CO2 includes bicarbonate and dissolved CO2, so 0.5-2 mmol/L cannot represent total CO2 when bicarbonate is 22-28 mmol/L.
Source: Abbott i-STAT CG4+ Cartridge Instructions for Use, page 3: https://www.globalpointofcare.abbott/content/dam/ardx/globalpointofcare/apoc/support/i-stat-1/cti-ifu/english-uk/ifu/765788-01B.pdf
The conditional PCO2 interval is [max(37, 22/coefficient), min(50, 28/coefficient)] with coefficient = 10^(pH - 7.608); it is nonempty throughout the sampled pH interval.
Each invocation refreshes all specimen attributes; report observations read the resulting snapshot without additional random draws. Oxygen partial pressure remains in the calling report.
